Calculate union exposure and formation rates

Source: R/calculate_union_rates.R
calculate_union_rates.Rd

Count union starts and unpartnered person-years by age, period, sex, and optionally previous_union: "none", "separated", or "widowed". The most recent episode's ending determines the category; each start counts in the category immediately before formation. Partnered time contributes no exposure. Men describe realized matching outcomes, not a male search-rate input. Typed entries pool cohabitation and direct marriage; conversion is excluded because partners remain partnered. Previous-category classification follows the population's recorded cohabitation policy, default FALSE without metadata. With dur_breaks, only none rows use age; separated/widowed rows use duration since the most recent ending; pool_dissolved can combine them.

Usage

calculate_union_rates(
  population,
  time_breaks,
  age_breaks,
  by_group = FALSE,
  by_previous_union = FALSE,
  dur_breaks = NULL,
  by_union_type = FALSE,
  conf.level = NULL,
  pool_dissolved = FALSE
)

Arguments

population

A hammel_population with person and union histories and a known endpoint. Observation cannot extend beyond that endpoint.

time_breaks

Strictly increasing finite calendar boundaries in years.

age_breaks

Strictly increasing nonnegative age boundaries in years. A finite final boundary gains an open-ended band through Inf.

by_group

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, require person groups and return separate rows by each individual's group. No pooled row is added.

by_previous_union

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, separate exposure and starts by previous union category and include previous_union. Otherwise pool counts and exposure before calculating rates, and omit that column. Supplying dur_breaks automatically enables this option.

dur_breaks

Optional nonnegative duration boundaries in years. When supplied, separated/widowed rows use years since the latest union ending; none rows still use age_breaks. Automatically enables by_previous_union regardless of its supplied value. A finite final boundary gains Inf. Adds dur_start/dur_end, with NA in the unused age/duration pair. Duration rows include all ages; this is not an age-by-duration surface.

by_union_type

Logical, default FALSE. Separate cohabitation and direct marriage entries. Requires typed histories. Both types use the same full unpartnered exposure; exposure must not be summed across type rows.

conf.level

NULL (default) to omit confidence intervals, or a finite numeric scalar strictly between 0 and 1. Adds conf_low and conf_high from two-sided exact stats::poisson.test() intervals for observed event counts over exposure. Bounds are NA at zero exposure. For fertility, these describe the observed rate, not the unrealized-adjusted rate.

pool_dissolved

Logical, default FALSE. With TRUE, return "none" and "dissolved", pooling separated and widowed events and exposure before calculating rates and confidence intervals. Requires by_previous_union (also enabled by dur_breaks). With FALSE, stratified output uses the detailed "none", "separated", and "widowed" categories.

Value

A tibble with time_start, time_end, sex, age_start, age_end, person_years, unions, and rate_union, plus group and previous_union when requested, and duration columns when dur_breaks is supplied, and union_type when requested. Empty cells are retained. With non-NULL conf.level, also includes conf_low and conf_high.

Details

Histories must be complete for the intended interpretation. "none" means no recorded earlier union; omitted history cannot establish never-partnered status. Overlapping episodes are rejected. Touching episodes are allowed; tied starts follow union ID order. Time and age cells are half-open, with events on internal boundaries assigned to the cell beginning there. Every episode counts, including zero-duration episodes. Rates are formations per unpartnered person-year, NA at zero exposure. Search attempts that fail to form unions are not counted, so these rates can differ from search hazards.
